claims: Denny Hamlin is a NASCAR driver.
Dennis Hamlin (75) is Denny Hamlin’s father.
Dennis Hamlin died following an accidental house fire in North Carolina on December 28, 2025.
The house fire critically injured Denny Hamlin's mother, Mary Lou.
The fire occurred near Stanley, NC.
The exact cause of the fire was deemed undetermined.
Denny Hamlin’s parents were found outside their home with severe injuries.
Mary Lou's condition was improving as of late February 2026, according to a Youtube video and a Taste of Country report.
Denny Hamlin has continued his NASCAR Cup Series campaign.
Denny Hamlin had an engine failure during practice in March 2026.
The investigation into the fire concluded that the blaze likely began in a bedroom.
The investigation into the fire did not identify a specific ignition source.
